core_obligations: First argument (proof lines 5563-5570): since the pullback of a module is the tensor product of the pullback of sheaves with the structure sheaf of the source, the statement follows from the description of stalks of pullbacks together with the commutation of taking stalks with tensor products.

Second, explicit argument (proof lines 5570-5602): choose a commutative square with U and V schemes surjective etale over X and Y, and lift the geometric point of X to a geometric point u of U with image v in V; then compute the stalk of the pullback step by step, rewriting along the identification of the pullback with the tensor product and using the descriptions of the stalks of quasi-coherent modules twice, to arrive at the tensor product of the stalk at the image point with the local ring of X at the given geometric point.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the tensor product description of the pullback and the stalk computations for sheaves of sets.
Alternatively run the computation explicitly on a compatible square of presentations with lifted geometric points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a morphism of algebraic spaces and a quasi-coherent module on the target, the stalk of the pullback at a geometric point is the tensor product of the stalk at the image geometric point with the local ring of the source at that point (statement lines 5547-5561). The proof (proof lines 5563-5606) gives a short argument through the tensor product description of the pullback and the stalk computations, and a second explicit argument on a compatible square of presentations with a lifted geometric point. H2: two routes with three inputs, written out in full.
